{{Top|leg}}
The '''blade scorpion''' was a large creature native to [[Nizon]]. They combined the traits of [[Crab/Legends|crabs]] and [[Scorpion/Legends|scorpions]] and were size of an [[Acklay/Legends|Acklay]]. They lived in the wastes of Nizon, tracking their prey by smell. The [[Nazren]] feared them and [[Vril Vrakth]] tried to protect himself from them by employing [[LM-432 crab droid/Legends|crab droids]].
